colorRoles.background: the window behind everything: the chat, the panels and the browser's start page
colorRoles.surface: panels, dialogs and cards on the background: the chat list, blocks in the chat, date separators
colorRoles.surface-variant: raised controls: the composer, fields, chips, toolbar buttons and your own messages
colorRoles.surface-nested: a block inside another block, such as the body of an open collapsible
colorRoles.on-surface-variant: secondary text and icons: summaries, captions, inactive icons
colorRoles.faint: the faintest text and marks: placeholders, timestamps and hints
colorRoles.hover: the tint under the pointer on rows and buttons
colorRoles.outline: visible borders and strokes, such as outlined buttons
colorRoles.outline-variant: subtle dividers and the hairline around menus and media
colorRoles.error: error text and the ring of a field in error
colorRoles.on-accent: text and icons on accent buttons
colorRoles.scrollbar-hover: the scrollbar thumb under the pointer
colorRoles.red: errors, danger buttons, deleted files, a context or plan limit nearly used up, the Bypass permissions mode and the caution alert in Markdown
colorRoles.red-bg: the tint behind removed lines in a diff and behind failed output
colorRoles.green: success, online dots, an idle chat, new files, the Accept edits mode and the tip alert in Markdown
colorRoles.green-bg: the tint behind added lines in a diff
colorRoles.blue: information notices, compacting, Plan mode, modified files, diff hunk headers and the note alert in Markdown
colorRoles.blue-bg: the tint behind a diff's hunk headers
colorRoles.yellow: the spinner of a chat retrying a request, degraded service status, warning lines in the server log and the warning alert in Markdown
colorRoles.orange: warnings, a chat waiting for you, an interrupted turn, the notice of a request being retried, a plan limit running low, a signed-out account, a network without internet and the Don't ask mode
colorRoles.purple: a chat being renamed, a commit message being written and the important alert in Markdown
colorRoles.gray: the Default permission mode, a chat opened from the trash and a service status that could not be read
colorRoles.logo: the tile of the CConnect logo, always dark: in a light theme a dark tone that fits its palette, never white
colorRoles.logo-ring: the faint full circle inside the logo, a tone between logo and logo-mark
colorRoles.logo-mark: the C and the prompt of the logo, in strong contrast with logo
